title: ProviderFailure
description: A typed provider failure. Adapters return this instead of throwing, so the Application can classify without parsing messages and Core never sees an exception.

category.description: Why the request did not yield usable output. Every value except MALFORMED_RESPONSE means NO RESPONSE ARRIVED. MALFORMED_RESPONSE means one did and could not be used — a model answered, and answering badly is not the same as not answering. That distinction is what decides which placeholder Core produces, so it must be carried by the category rather than inferred downstream (ADR-0014).

safe_message.description: Safe to LOG and DISPLAY to an operator: it never contains request content or credentials. That is the whole of the claim, and it is narrower than it reads. Adapters derive this partly from the provider's own response body - hosted-server lifts error.message from the upstream JSON, ollama interpolates the daemon's response text, local-proxy uses body.error.message - so the far end influences it. It is therefore NOT safe to embed in a persisted artifact that later stages read and the gates lint. core/src/stages/stage-kit.ts did exactly that in the degradation placeholder until 6 September 2026; use reason_code and category there, which are ours.
